roles.adminDescription: Full access, including users, libraries and server settings.
roles.managerDescription: Can edit tags, upload, rename and delete files.
roles.downloadDescription: Can download original files and albums.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who can sign in to Rainy and what they may do.
users.createDescription: They can sign in with this username and password — also from Subsonic apps.
users.deleteDescription: Their playlists, favorites and play history are deleted too. Music files are not touched.
users.selfAdmin: You can't remove your own administrator role.
users.selfDelete: You can't delete your own account.
users.resetHint: Share it with them securely; they can change it in their settings.

validation.usernameInvalid: Use letters, digits and . _ - @ + only (no spaces).

libraries.title: Libraries & scanning
libraries.subtitle: Music folders Rainy indexes, and their scan status.
libraries.dialogDescription: A folder on the server that contains music.
libraries.deleteDescription: Its tracks are removed from Rainy's database (with plays and favorites). The files on disk stay untouched.
libraries.emptyDescription: Add the folder that contains your music.
libraries.pathHint: The path as the server sees it — in Docker that's the path inside the container, e.g. /music.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.subtitle: Settings for everyone using this server.

fields.onlineMetadataChinaIp: Pretend to search from mainland China

help.scanInterval: How often to look for new or changed files.
help.fixEncodingOnScan: Show GBK / Big5 / Shift-JIS tags correctly. Files are not modified.
help.genreSeparators: Characters that split one genre tag into several.
help.ignoredArticles: Words skipped when sorting artists (“The Beatles” under B).
help.coverArtFiles: Folder images used as album covers, in priority order.
help.onlineMetadata: Lets managers search NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo and iTunes from the tag editor. The server sends the search terms to these services; nothing is sent until someone searches.
help.onlineMetadataChinaIp: Adds an X-Real-IP header with a random mainland-China address to NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou and Kuwo requests, which hide some songs from searches outside China. The header is spoofed and not guaranteed to work; iTunes and cover downloads never get it.
help.transcodeFormat: Used when a client asks for a lower bitrate.
help.enableDownloads: Users with the download permission can save original files.
help.renamePattern: Used by Rename / organize and uploads with “Organize by tags”.

validation.duration: Use a duration like 30m or 6h (0 turns it off).
validation.pattern: The pattern needs at least one token like {title}.

ytdlp.enable: Allow downloads from YouTube and bilibili
ytdlp.enableHelp: Managers can paste a link on the Upload page; the server downloads the audio with yt-dlp and adds it to the library. The server contacts YouTube or bilibili only when someone starts a download, and GitHub only when you check for or install an update.
ytdlp.managedHelp: Rainy installs the official yt-dlp release in the data folder.
ytdlp.unmanagedHelp: Managed by the server operator (RAINY_YTDLP_PATH); update it there.
ytdlp.updatesHelp: YouTube changes often, so keep yt-dlp up to date. It is downloaded from GitHub and verified against the release checksums.
ytdlp.enableFirst: Turn on downloads from links first.
ytdlp.requirementsHelp: ffmpeg extracts the audio; a JavaScript runtime solves YouTube’s challenges.
ytdlp.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg not found; downloads can’t run
ytdlp.jsRuntimeMissing: No JavaScript runtime; YouTube downloads may fail

warning.title: Cookies are the keys to your account
warning.body: Providing cookies is the same as handing over access to your account: a malicious program that gets hold of them can impersonate you.
warning.never: Never share your cookies with anyone or paste them anywhere you don’t trust. Consider signing in with a separate account for downloads.
warning.local: Rainy stores them encrypted on this server only and never uploads them to any external network. During a download, yt-dlp sends them only to the site they belong to, just as your browser does.

cookies.help: Optional. With sign-in cookies, yt-dlp can download members-only or age-restricted videos and higher-quality audio. Public videos work without them.
cookies.removeDescription: Downloads will run without signing in. The session stays valid in your browser; sign out there to revoke it.
cookies.dialogDescription: Export the cookies from a browser where you are signed in, then paste them here.
cookies.step1: Install the <ext>Get cookies.txt LOCALLY<icon/></ext> extension in Chrome or Edge. It exports cookies without sending them anywhere.
cookies.step2youtube: Open a private (incognito) window, allow the extension there, and sign in to YouTube. Export from that window and close it afterwards: YouTube soon invalidates the cookies of a session that stays open.
cookies.step3: On {{domain}}, click the extension and choose Export for the current site. Don’t export the cookies of all sites.
cookies.step4: Choose the downloaded cookies.txt file, or paste its content below.
cookies.tooLarge: The file is too large for a cookies.txt export.
cookies.keepsOnly: Only cookies for {{domain}} are kept; everything else is discarded. The text is never shown again after saving.
cookies.dropped_one: {{count}} cookie of another site was discarded.
cookies.dropped_other: {{count}} cookies of other sites were discarded.
cookies.notSignedInHint: They don’t include a sign-in; make sure you were signed in when exporting.

sources.enable: Allow online music and music sources
sources.enableHelp: Managers can then search online catalogues in Tracks → Online and download songs into a library. Music sources are lx-music custom source scripts that run on this server and contact the servers their authors chose.

modes.autoHelp: Try the enabled sources from top to bottom until one delivers the song.
modes.fixedHelp: Only the chosen source is asked; if it fails, the download fails.
modes.fixedUnavailable: This source is disabled or removed; downloads will fail until you choose another one.

sources.help: Order sets the priority for automatic fallback. Rainy doesn’t include any source: import scripts you trust.
sources.empty: No sources yet. Import an lx-music custom source script (.js).
sources.removeDescription: The script is deleted from the server. Songs already downloaded stay in the library.

import.title: Import a music source
import.description: An lx-music custom source script (.js), from a file or a link.
import.warning: A source script is third-party code. It runs on this server, may contact any public internet address, and receives the songs you download. Rainy limits its time, network and inputs, but not its memory use.
import.fileHint: The script is sent to the server and stored there; it is never shown again.
import.tooLarge: The script is larger than 9 MB.
import.urlHint: The server downloads the script and remembers the link, so it can update it later.
import.urlNeedsEnable: Turn on online music first: the server downloads the script from the link.
